antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in pneumocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Gentle regeneration: 345 THz (870nm) at low power, continuous, targets neuron mitochondria targeting cytochrome_c in pneumocyte. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial uncoupling_protein_UCP1 activation.
